{{Quote|I'm ''sorry'', General. Since the crash, I've been&hellip; rather ''twitchy''.|The clone trooper, to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Hunted (comic)" />}}
A '''clone trooper''' was part of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] task force sent to retrieve the coordinates for the [[hypermatter generator]]s of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. However, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] he was [[Mission to Asuin|rescued]] on [[Asuin]], he was the only survivor of his [[Squad/Legends|squad]] aside from the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[J-3PO]].<ref name="Hunted (comic)" />
